$comment: Writable Incus config keys for set_lxc_config. Any key not listed is rejected. Every write snapshots the guest first.

security.nesting.note: Required true for Docker inside the guest. Low risk.

security.privileged.warning: Privileged means container root IS host root: a compromise inside the guest is a host compromise. Prefer raising kernel.keys.* sysctls on the host, which fixes the Docker keyring failure with isolation intact. Also changes uid mapping — file ownership inside the guest shifts, so existing data directories may need re-chowning.
security.privileged.note: This exact flip was the field session's blocker; the tool must present the warning, not just apply the change.

limits.memory.note: Browser workloads need >= 4GB; Chrome OOMs at 2GB.

explicitly_not_writable.raw.lxc: Arbitrary LXC config injection — equivalent to unrestricted host-level control.
explicitly_not_writable.raw.idmap: uid-mapping changes can orphan every file in the guest.
explicitly_not_writable.security.syscalls.*: Syscall filter changes are host-security-relevant and rare enough to stay manual.
explicitly_not_writable.devices (disk/nic passthrough): Device attachment reaches host resources; keep manual.
